title: Grand Canyon National Park Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: 7 hours allocated for transport and rest stops
Please Note: National Park fees may apply for international visitors. If applicable, this fee is collected in-destination and not at the time of booking.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience so much more of Arizona on this Grand Canyon Tour. You’ll see some of the best Arizona vistas on the way to the National Park from low desert to alpine forests. Plenty of wildlife, too!

At the National Park your Tour Guide will take you to some of the most amazing Grand Canyon scenic overlooks, and you’ll also visit historic buildings constructed well over 100 years ago before Grand Canyon was a national park! Lunch is included with your tour at the Grand Canyon Explorers Cafe!

Don’t forget your camera, as one of the 7 wonders of the natural world, this tour provides endless and amazing views.

Remember, because we climb much higher in altitude, it is always approx. 30 degrees cooler on the Grand Canyon National Park Tour.
